as_of_note: Compiled 2026-10-30 by the India source-audit lane. CONTEXT ONLY, never a scoring input. Indian official figures use the April-March fiscal year (FY 2025-26 = 1 Apr 2025 to 31 Mar 2026); 'year' holds the calendar year in which that fiscal year ENDS, and 'year_basis' says which. EIA figures are calendar years and differ in scope from Indian official series (EIA 2024 generation 2,051.8 BkWh vs CEA FY 2024-25 1,828.88 BU) - never mix the two in one series. PPAC FY 2025-26 data are provisional and revised (crude imports 245.8 MMT in the Ready Reckoner, 246.6 MMT in the PPAC table updated 21-10-2026). CEA capacity is utilities only and excludes long-outage units removed temporarily from the installed base. Official refining totals disagree (248.866 MoPNG / 258.1 PPAC Ready Reckoner / 267.116 PPAC capacity page incl. HRRL). See docs/countries/IN_SOURCE_AUDIT.md.

significance: EIA puts India's 2024 primary energy production at 22.35 quadrillion Btu, about 60% of its 37.49 quadrillion Btu of consumption.
Coal supplied about 78% of that 2024 production (17.34 quadrillion Btu, EIA).
Coal-based plants were 40.27% of India's 558.9 GW of utility generating capacity on 30 September 2026 (CEA).
Imported crude made up 90.5% of the 272.0 million tonnes processed by Indian refineries in FY 2025-26 (PPAC, provisional).
